external_collaboration.partner_name: Cohehre Consortium of Higher education Health and Rehabilitation Institutions
external_collaboration.evidence_quote: The school became a member of Cohehre Consortium of Higher education Health and Rehabilitation Institutions based in Denmark. The membership allows our teachers and students to participate in conferences and student exchange programs.
Bilateral cooperation has been organized with College of Nursing in Celje, Slovenia. Cooperation within Erasmus is reflected in the exchange of professors over a period of one year.
Our College is a full member of Tempus IV project with other Colleges of the Academy from Belgium, Germany and Portugal EACEA-517200.
